# Available variables: # - env, model, record, records, time, datetime, dateutil, timezone # - float_compare, log, _logger, UserError, Command # ================================================================= # Coherencia entre x_studio_solution_state_1, x_studio_fake y # x_studio_handled. Recalcula el estado del survey en función # de cuántas líneas relevantes están handled. # # TRIGGER: Al crear y actualizar # CAMPOS OBSERVADOS: x_studio_solution_state_1, user_input_line_ids # =================================================================
# -------- CONSTANTES -------- TARGET_QUESTION_IDS = (207, 265, 266) STATE_COMPLETED = 'completed' STATE_NEW = 'new' STATE_WIP = 'work in progress' STATES_OPEN = (STATE_NEW, STATE_WIP) SKIP_DISPLAY_NAME = "Omitida"
# -------- CACHE LOCAL -------- # Una sola lectura del recordset y del estado actual. lines = record.user_input_line_ids current_state = record.x_studio_solution_state_1
# Líneas que cuentan para el cálculo de estado. # Nota: el filtro por display_name es frágil en multilingüe; # si traduces "Omitida" hay que ajustarlo (o migrar a un # booleano Studio explícito). relevant_lines = lines.filtered( lambda l: not l.skipped and l.display_name != SKIP_DISPLAY_NAME )
# -------- 1. SYNC fake -> handled -------- # Si una línea está marcada como fake, también debe quedar handled. # Se dispara cuando se guardan cambios de líneas a través del padre, # gracias a que user_input_line_ids está en los watched fields. fake_pending = lines.filtered( lambda l: l.x_studio_fake and not l.x_studio_handled ) if fake_pending: fake_pending.write({'x_studio_handled': True})
# -------- 2. Si COMPLETED -> todo relevante queda handled -------- if current_state == STATE_COMPLETED: to_handle = relevant_lines.filtered(lambda l: not l.x_studio_handled) if to_handle: to_handle.write({'x_studio_handled': True})
# -------- 3. Si NEW o WIP -> preguntas objetivo handled -------- if current_state in STATES_OPEN: target_pending = lines.filtered( lambda l: l.question_id.id in TARGET_QUESTION_IDS and not l.x_studio_handled ) if target_pending: target_pending.write({'x_studio_handled': True})
# -------- 4. Recalcular estado según handled -------- # Una sola pasada con sum() en vez de all() + any() separados. if relevant_lines: total = len(relevant_lines) handled_count = sum(1 for l in relevant_lines if l.x_studio_handled)
if handled_count == total: new_state = STATE_COMPLETED elif handled_count > 0: new_state = STATE_WIP else: new_state = current_state # sin cambio
# Change guard: solo escribir si el estado realmente cambia. if new_state != current_state: record.write({'x_studio_solution_state_1': new_state})

# Available variables: # - env: environment on which the action is triggered # - model: model of the record on which the action is triggered; is a void recordset # - record: record on which the action is triggered; may be void # - records: recordset of all records on which the action is triggered in multi-mode; may be void # - time, datetime, dateutil, timezone: useful Python libraries # - float_compare: utility function to compare floats based on specific precision # - log: log(message, level='info'): logging function to record debug information in ir.logging table # - _logger: _logger.info(message): logger to emit messages in server logs # - UserError: exception class for raising user-facing warning messages # - Command: x2many commands namespace # To return an action, assign: action = {...}
# Autor del chatter (buddy - usuario 171) author_partner = env['res.users'].browse(171).partner_id
for record in records: user = record.write_uid user_name = user.name if user else "Unknown user" state = record.x_studio_solution_state_1
if state not in ['work in progress', 'completed']: continue
# Idioma del usuario que modifica lang = user.lang if user and user.lang else 'en_US'
# Traducciones simples if lang.startswith('es'): message = f"El estado de la solución cambió a '{state}' por el usuario {user_name}" elif lang.startswith('fr'): message = f"L'état de la solution est passé à '{state}' par l'utilisateur {user_name}" else: message = f"Solution state changed to '{state}' by user {user_name}"
# Buscar último mensaje last_message = env['mail.message'].search( [ ('res_id', '=', record.id), ('model', '=', record._name), ('message_type', '=', 'comment'), ], order='date desc', limit=1 )
if last_message and state in (last_message.body or ''): continue
# Publicar mensaje en el idioma correcto record.with_context(lang=lang).message_post( body=message, author_id=author_partner.id, message_type="comment", subtype_xmlid="mail.mt_note" )

# ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ # COMPRAS DESDE ENCUESTA — Acción de servidor (production-ready) # ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ # Modelo: survey.user_input # Trigger: botón "Ver / Crear compras" en la encuesta # # Flujo: por cada encuesta seleccionada lee el almacén del partner y # los productos respondidos, los clasifica contra POs en borrador del # mismo almacén y bifurca en 3 casos: # # ┌──────────────────────────────┬──────────────────────────────────┐ # │ CASO │ COMPORTAMIENTO │ # ├──────────────────────────────┼──────────────────────────────────┤ # │ A · todos en PO draft │ abre lista filtrada │ # │ B · ninguno en PO │ crea PO(s) agrupando proveedores │ # │ C · parcial (algunos sí) │ auto-añade faltantes a la PO │ # │ │ existente y la abre │ # └──────────────────────────────┴──────────────────────────────────┘ # # Idempotencia: # - CASO B y C verifican que no exista ya el producto antes de crear/añadir # - Re-ejecutar la acción no duplica líneas # # Auditoría: chatter en la PO y en la encuesta para toda operación de # escritura. Campo `origin` con timestamp de finalización de la encuesta. # ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── # CONSTANTES — single source of truth # ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── LIST_LIMIT = 5 # límite de filas al abrir lista de POs DEFAULT_QTY = 1.0 # cantidad inicial de líneas creadas INCOMING_CODE = "incoming" # stock.picking.type.code para recepciones ADDABLE_STATE = "draft" # único estado de PO al que se le añaden líneas DATE_FORMAT = "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M" NO_PARTNER_TXT = "Sin contacto" NO_DATE_TXT = "sin fecha"
# ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── # HELPERS · notificaciones # ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── def notify(title, message, ntype="warning", sticky=False): """Acción cliente: toast en la esquina superior derecha.""" return { "type": "ir.actions.client", "tag": "display_notification", "params": { "title": title, "message": message, "type": ntype, "sticky": sticky, }, }
# ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── # HELPERS · extracción de datos # ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── def get_products_from_input(user_input): """Productos únicos respondidos en una encuesta (recordset).""" products = env["product.product"] for line in user_input.user_input_line_ids: if "suggested_answer_ids" in line._fields: answers = line.suggested_answer_ids else: answers = line.suggested_answer_id or env["survey.question.answer"] products |= answers.mapped("x_studio_product_product_id") return products
def build_origin(source_record): """ Texto para purchase.order.origin. Formato: '<end_datetime local> - <partner_name>' Ej.: '2026-05-12 14:30 - Opera 14' """ end_dt = source_record.end_datetime if end_dt: # end_datetime en BD es naive UTC. Convertimos a la zona horaria # del usuario usando dateutil.tz (pytz/fields no están disponibles # en safe_eval, pero dateutil sí). user_tz_name = source_record.env.user.tz or "UTC" utc_tz = dateutil.tz.tzutc() user_tz = dateutil.tz.gettz(user_tz_name) end_local = end_dt.replace(tzinfo=utc_tz).astimezone(user_tz) end_str = end_local.strftime(DATE_FORMAT) else: end_str = NO_DATE_TXT
partner_name = source_record.partner_id.name or NO_PARTNER_TXT return "%s - %s" % (end_str, partner_name)
# ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── # HELPERS · clasificación de productos # ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── def split_matched_unmatched(warehouse, products): """ Particiona `products` en (matched, unmatched) con UNA query.
matched = aparece en ≥1 PO en estado draft del almacén dado. unmatched = no aparece en ninguna PO draft (o solo en POs cerradas).
Una PO en `sent`/`purchase`/`done` NO cuenta como match porque ya no se le pueden añadir líneas sin renegociar con el proveedor. """ empty = env["product.product"] if not products: return empty, empty
groups = env["purchase.order.line"].read_group( domain=[ ("product_id", "in", products.ids), ("order_id.picking_type_id.warehouse_id", "=", warehouse.id), ("order_id.state", "=", ADDABLE_STATE), ], fields=["product_id"], groupby=["product_id"], ) matched_ids = [g["product_id"][0] for g in groups] matched = products.filtered_domain([("id", "in", matched_ids)]) unmatched = products - matched return matched, unmatched
# ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── # HELPERS · construcción de acciones de vista # ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── def build_search_domain(pairs): """ Dominio OR para listar POs draft que toquen (almacén, productos). `pairs` = [(warehouse, products_recordset), ...] """ clauses = [] for warehouse, prods in pairs: clauses += [ "&", ("order_line.product_id", "in", prods.ids), ("picking_type_id.warehouse_id", "=", warehouse.id), ] or_prefix = ["|"] * (len(pairs) - 1) if len(pairs) > 1 else [] return or_prefix + clauses + [("state", "=", ADDABLE_STATE)]
def build_list_action(domain, name="Compras relacionadas"): """Vista lista de purchase.order filtrada por dominio.""" return { "type": "ir.actions.act_window", "name": name, "res_model": "purchase.order", "views": [[False, "list"], [False, "form"]], "view_mode": "list,form", "domain": domain, "context": {"search_default_groupby_warehouse": 1}, "limit": LIST_LIMIT, }
def build_po_view(po_ids, name_single, name_multi): """ Decide entre form (1 PO) o lista (varias) para mostrar resultado. Usado tras crear o actualizar POs. """ if len(po_ids) == 1: return { "type": "ir.actions.act_window", "name": name_single, "res_model": "purchase.order", "res_id": po_ids[0], "views": [[False, "form"]], "view_mode": "form", } return { "type": "ir.actions.act_window", "name": name_multi, "res_model": "purchase.order", "domain": [("id", "in", po_ids)], "views": [[False, "list"], [False, "form"]], "view_mode": "list,form", }
# ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── # HELPERS · creación / modificación de POs # ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── def create_pos_from_products(warehouse, products, source_record): """ Crea una PO por proveedor preferido.
Jerarquía para decidir el proveedor de cada producto: 1. stock.warehouse.orderpoint del almacén → supplier_id (la regla de reabastecimiento manda; resuelve el caso de productos con varios proveedores en la ficha) 2. Fallback: product.seller_ids[:1] (primer proveedor por sequence) 3. Sin ninguno → no_supplier, reportado al caller
Devuelve (created_pos_recordset, products_without_supplier_recordset). """ picking_type = env["stock.picking.type"].search( [ ("warehouse_id", "=", warehouse.id), ("code", "=", INCOMING_CODE), ], limit=1, )
# ─── Mapa producto → partner_id según orderpoint del almacén ─── # Una sola query para todos los productos (más barato que N searches). orderpoints = env["stock.warehouse.orderpoint"].search([ ("product_id", "in", products.ids), ("warehouse_id", "=", warehouse.id), ("supplier_id", "!=", False), ]) op_supplier_by_product = {} # {product_id: partner_id} for op in orderpoints: # Si un producto tiene varios orderpoints (raro), el primero gana. # En la práctica el orderpoint es único por (producto, almacén). if op.product_id.id not in op_supplier_by_product: op_supplier_by_product[op.product_id.id] = op.supplier_id.partner_id.id
# ─── Agrupar productos por proveedor resuelto ─── by_supplier = {} # {supplier_id: recordset} no_supplier = env["product.product"]
for product in products: # 1º intentar regla de reabastecimiento supplier_id = op_supplier_by_product.get(product.id)
# 2º fallback a seller_ids if not supplier_id: seller = product.seller_ids[:1] if not seller: no_supplier |= product continue supplier_id = seller.partner_id.id
if supplier_id not in by_supplier: by_supplier[supplier_id] = env["product.product"] by_supplier[supplier_id] |= product
# ─── Crear una PO por proveedor ─── created_pos = env["purchase.order"] origin = build_origin(source_record)
for supplier_id, prods in by_supplier.items(): line_commands = [ (0, 0, {"product_id": p.id, "product_qty": DEFAULT_QTY}) for p in prods ] po_vals = { "partner_id": supplier_id, "order_line": line_commands, "origin": origin, } if picking_type: po_vals["picking_type_id"] = picking_type.id
po = env["purchase.order"].create(po_vals) names = ", ".join(prods.mapped("display_name"))
po.message_post( body="Compra creada desde encuesta. Productos: %s" % names ) source_record.message_post( body="Compra %s creada con productos: %s" % (po.name, names) ) created_pos |= po
return created_pos, no_supplier
def add_products_to_po(po, products_to_check, source_record): """ Añade a `po` los productos de `products_to_check` que NO estén ya en sus líneas. Devuelve el recordset realmente añadido (puede ser vacío si ya estaban todos).
Idempotente: re-ejecutar no duplica líneas. """ existing_ids = po.order_line.mapped("product_id").ids products_to_add = products_to_check.filtered_domain( [("id", "not in", existing_ids)] )
if not products_to_add: return products_to_add # recordset vacío
new_lines = [ (0, 0, {"product_id": p.id, "product_qty": DEFAULT_QTY}) for p in products_to_add ] po.write({"order_line": new_lines})
names = ", ".join(products_to_add.mapped("display_name")) po.message_post( body="Productos agregados desde encuesta: %s" % names ) source_record.message_post( body="Productos agregados a %s: %s" % (po.name, names) ) return products_to_add
# ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ # FLUJO PRINCIPAL # ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── # 1 · Validación temprana # ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── if not records: action = notify("Sin registros", "No hay encuestas seleccionadas.")
else: # ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── # 2 · Clasificar cada encuesta — una pasada, una query por encuesta # ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── errors = [] # (record, motivo) → reportar por chatter valid_pairs = [] # dicts con datos clasificados
for record in records: partner = record.partner_id warehouse = partner.x_studio_warehouse_id
if not warehouse: errors.append((record, "sin almacén asignado")) continue
products = get_products_from_input(record) if not products: errors.append((record, "sin productos en las respuestas")) continue
matched, unmatched = split_matched_unmatched(warehouse, products)
valid_pairs.append({ "warehouse": warehouse, "products": products, "matched": matched, "unmatched": unmatched, "record": record, })
# ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── # 3 · Resolver según el diagnóstico # ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── if not valid_pairs: # Ningún registro válido — listar motivos en popup lines = [ "• %s: %s." % (r.partner_id.name or NO_PARTNER_TXT, msg) for r, msg in errors ] action = notify( "No se pudo procesar ninguna encuesta", "\n".join(lines), ntype="danger", sticky=True, )
else: # Reportar fallos parciales en su propio chatter for record, msg in errors: record.message_post( body="⚠️ No se pudieron abrir compras: %s." % msg )
# Diagnóstico agregado para decidir el caso has_any_matched = any(p["matched"] for p in valid_pairs) has_any_unmatched = any(p["unmatched"] for p in valid_pairs)
# ─── CASO A · todos los productos tienen PO draft ───────────── if not has_any_unmatched: domain = build_search_domain( [(p["warehouse"], p["products"]) for p in valid_pairs] ) action = build_list_action(domain)
# ─── CASO B · ningún producto tiene PO → crear desde cero ───── elif not has_any_matched: created_pos = env["purchase.order"]
for pair in valid_pairs: pos, no_supp = create_pos_from_products( pair["warehouse"], pair["products"], pair["record"] ) created_pos |= pos
if no_supp: names = ", ".join(no_supp.mapped("display_name")) pair["record"].message_post( body="⚠️ Productos sin proveedor configurado " "(ni en regla de reabastecimiento ni en ficha, " "no incluidos en compra): %s" % names )
if not created_pos: action = notify( "Sin compras creadas", "Ningún producto tiene proveedor configurado. " "Define proveedor en la regla de reabastecimiento " "del almacén o en la pestaña Compra del producto.", ntype="danger", sticky=True, ) else: action = build_po_view( created_pos.ids, name_single="Nueva compra", name_multi ="Nuevas compras", )
# ─── CASO C · parcial → auto-añadir faltantes a PO existente ── else: affected_po_ids = [] has_ambiguous = False
for pair in valid_pairs: if not pair["unmatched"]: continue # esta encuesta está completa, nada que hacer
# Localizar la PO destino. Si hay 0 o más de 1 → ambigüedad matching_pos = env["purchase.order"].search([ ("state", "=", ADDABLE_STATE), ("picking_type_id.warehouse_id", "=", pair["warehouse"].id), ("order_line.product_id", "in", pair["matched"].ids), ])
if len(matching_pos) != 1: has_ambiguous = True continue
po = matching_pos added = add_products_to_po(po, pair["unmatched"], pair["record"])
# Registrar la PO afectada aunque `added` esté vacío # (puede pasar tras un doble click → idempotencia) if po.id not in affected_po_ids: affected_po_ids.append(po.id)
# Decidir vista de salida if has_ambiguous: # Resolución manual: lista filtrada pairs_for_list = [ (p["warehouse"], p["matched"]) for p in valid_pairs if p["matched"] ] action = build_list_action(build_search_domain(pairs_for_list))
elif affected_po_ids: action = build_po_view( affected_po_ids, name_single="Compra actualizada", name_multi ="Compras actualizadas", )
else: action = notify( "Sin cambios", "Los productos ya estaban en la compra.", ntype="info", )

# ============================================================ # Constants (single source of truth) # ------------------------------------------------------------ # NOTE: Hardcoded record IDs are fragile across DB instances. # If you ever migrate or duplicate this DB, replace these with # env.ref(...) lookups via a stable XML ID or external reference. # ============================================================ SUPPLIER_PARTNER_ID = 5376 # res.partner: Amazon (proveedor fijo) DELIVERY_QUESTION_ID = 283 # survey.question: pregunta de entrega SURVEY_COMPLETED_STATE = 'completed' # x_studio_solution_state_1 final ORIGIN_PREFIX = 'Survey '
# ============================================================ # Pre-checks: idempotency guard # Avoid duplicating POs if the action is re-run on the same set. # ============================================================ already_created = records.filtered(lambda r: r.x_studio_purchase_order) if already_created: raise UserError( "Purchase order already created for record(s): %s" % already_created.ids )
# ============================================================ # Batch partner -> user lookup (avoids N+1 queries inside loop) # ============================================================ partner_ids = records.mapped('partner_id').ids users = env['res.users'].search([('partner_id', 'in', partner_ids)]) user_by_partner = {u.partner_id.id: u for u in users}
# ============================================================ # Main loop: one PO per survey input # ============================================================ for record in records: survey = record.survey_id user = user_by_partner.get(record.partner_id.id) picking_type = False delivery_answer = '' survey_summary = []
# --- Single pass over input lines --- for line in record.user_input_line_ids: # Resolve the display value for this line if line.suggested_answer_id: answer_value = line.suggested_answer_id.value elif line.value_char_box: answer_value = line.value_char_box elif line.value_text_box: answer_value = line.value_text_box elif line.value_numerical_box not in (False, None): answer_value = str(line.value_numerical_box) elif line.value_date: answer_value = str(line.value_date) else: answer_value = ''
# Capture the delivery-question answer (first match wins) if ( not delivery_answer and line.question_id and line.question_id.id == DELIVERY_QUESTION_ID ): delivery_answer = answer_value
# Capture picking type from suggested answer (first match wins) if ( not picking_type and line.suggested_answer_id and line.suggested_answer_id.x_studio_delivery_address ): picking_type = line.suggested_answer_id.x_studio_delivery_address
# Build human-readable summary line question_label = line.question_id.title if line.question_id else '' if question_label and answer_value: survey_summary.append('%s: %s' % (question_label, answer_value))
# --- Build PO values --- company = picking_type.company_id if picking_type else env.company origin_parts = [ORIGIN_PREFIX + str(record.id), survey.title] if delivery_answer: origin_parts.append(delivery_answer)
po_vals = { 'partner_id': SUPPLIER_PARTNER_ID, 'origin': ' - '.join(p for p in origin_parts if p), } if user: po_vals['user_id'] = user.id if picking_type: po_vals['picking_type_id'] = picking_type.id po_vals['company_id'] = company.id
# --- Create PO --- po = env['purchase.order'].with_company(company).create(po_vals)
# --- Update survey record: link PO and mark as completed --- record.write({ 'x_studio_purchase_order': po.id, 'x_studio_solution_state_1': SURVEY_COMPLETED_STATE, })
# --- Post traceability messages --- author_partner_id = ( survey.user_id.partner_id.id if survey.user_id else env.user.partner_id.id )
record.message_post( body='Purchase Order created: ' + po.name, author_id=author_partner_id, )
if survey_summary: lines_text = '\n'.join(survey_summary) po.message_post( body='Survey: ' + survey.title + '\n' + lines_text, author_id=author_partner_id, message_type='comment', subtype_xmlid='mail.mt_note', )

# ============================================================ # Constants (single source of truth) # ============================================================ SERVER_ACTION_ID = 1732 TARGET_SURVEY_ID = 24 # survey.survey: "Compras Amazon" BATCH_LIMIT = 100 # max records processed per tick (safety cap)
# ============================================================ # Find surveys ready to be turned into Purchase Orders: # - belong to the target survey (Compras Amazon, id=24) # - user finished filling the survey # - no Purchase Order linked yet # - survey state is not 'completed' # ============================================================ pending = env['survey.user_input'].search( [ ('survey_id', '=', TARGET_SURVEY_ID), ('state', '=', 'done'), ('x_studio_purchase_order', '=', False), ('x_studio_solution_state_1', '!=', 'completed'), ], limit=BATCH_LIMIT, )
# Nothing to do this tick — skip silently if pending: env['ir.actions.server'].browse(SERVER_ACTION_ID).with_context( active_model='survey.user_input', active_ids=pending.ids, active_id=pending[:1].id, ).run()
